comments.text: Places humans can’t go, even if you’re a billionaire… Yet people go to these places all the time. Normal members of the military (not billionaires) work at Area 51, people work at that seed vault, you can freely go to that island off the coast of India (but it’s technically illegal and you have a 98% chance of being killed by the natives), Presidents and billionaires go to that forest in California, etc. Besides maybe Chernobyl, “humans“ can (and have) gone to all these places. I understand what you’re trying to say in this video, but it should’ve been more like “These are places you probably shouldn’t go because it’s dangerous, illegal, etc.“.
